name: produce-game-2d-map-assets
job: Produce 2D map tiles, terrain sheets, and prop packs with extraction, layering, and seam QC.

inScope: Producing tileable terrain, water, walls, and prop sheets
Extracting transparent props and composing layered previews
Verifying seams, alpha edges, and naming
Delivering title-repo asset paths with QC notes
outOfScope: Title map data and world layout (app repo)
Pack, player, and platform emit (Keel pack)
Inventing flags for helper scripts without reading --help

inputs: Tile size, atlas layout, prop density, and style contract
Source art or generation tools available on the host
outputs: Tile and prop files at title-repo asset paths

data: style contract matching characters and UI
permissions: write access to the title assets tree

failureSemantics: Seams are verified with real 2x2 or larger composites; props are isolated on keyable background without baked text; assets failing seam, identity, or naming QC are residual defects, not silently shipped.

outcome.observable: Tile or prop packs at the declared title paths with real seam composites, alpha-edge and naming QC notes, preview images, and an honest residual list.
